title: Owl Teapot and Phoenix Wing
description: A surreal still life features a large white owl teapot with antlers and a golden crown, its body filled with glowing amber liquid. A massive feathered wing covered in text extends from the teapot across an old wooden table holding an open book, a vintage camera, a scroll with a maze, and scattered purple petals under a dramatic sunset sky filled with floating letters.
prompt: Surreal fantasy still life at sunset, a majestic white owl teapot wearing a golden crown and large antlers, its glass body filled with glowing amber tea, a giant phoenix wing covered in printed text extending from its side across a wooden table. On the table are an open old book, vintage camera, scroll with maze diagram, scattered purple petals, and ink splatters. Dramatic sky with floating letters, rolling hills in background, highly detailed, cinematic lighting.
